Hey Kay,

I asked Brendan Burdette and Ryan Conner, co-founders of Braddock Road Insurance Corporation, to do a private session for the Agency M&A community on something I think more acquisition-minded agency owners need to understand:

Personal Guarantee Insurance.

If you’re using SBA 7(a) financing to acquire an agency, the leverage can be incredibly useful.

But the personal guarantee is the part most buyers don’t fully appreciate until they’re deep into the process.

You’re not just signing loan documents.

You’re potentially putting your home, savings, and family balance sheet on the line if the deal does not go the way you expected.

That doesn’t mean SBA financing is bad. I still think it can be one of the most powerful tools available for lower-middle-market acquisitions.

But you need to understand the risk you’re taking.

Brendan and Ryan are joining us to walk through Personal Guarantee Insurance, the first regulated U.S. insurance product built to reduce the personal guarantee risk on SBA loans.

👉 Register now ( https://5effc869.click.kit-mail3. )​

They’ll cover:

* Why the personal guarantee is the hidden cost of every SBA-financed acquisition

* How Personal Guarantee Insurance works

What it covers

* How it fits inside a normal SBA closing

* Eligibility, pricing, and how to get a quote

* We’ll also leave time for live Q&A, so you can ask questions directly.

The session is:

* Personal Guarantee Insurance: Reducing the Personal Risk Out of SBA Loans

* Monday, July 13

* 10:00–11:00 am CDT

If you’re actively looking at acquisitions, considering SBA financing, or trying to understand the real downside risk behind an SBA-backed deal, this is worth attending.
